work.title: Readable provider sustainability Analyze view
authority: Direct user instruction: make the G4 Analyze page easy to read

intent.productGoal: Make run-bound provider-departure evidence understandable without converting it into an unapproved QoR conclusion.
intent.capability: Present observed billed concentration alongside provider roster FTE, dates, a valuation-relative status, and source-row trace in G4 Analyze.
architecturalIntent: Use the existing run-bound analysis.providerSustainability and provider roster data; do not introduce a separate calculation system.
Separate observed evidence, calculated values, and professional interpretation in the visual hierarchy.
invariants: Provider departure is presented as review evidence, not an automatic QoR adjustment or professional conclusion.
The unresolved reconciliation difference and release authority remain unaffected.
Every roster-status row remains traceable to its source file and row.
acceptanceEvidence: Workbench JavaScript syntax check and asset build.
Browser observation of G4 Analyze at 1920px width for run 573bc172-0c62-41a7-af87-84171b94280e.
Run API evidence demonstrating the providerSustainability data is bound to the same run.

decisions.decision: Replace dense provider concentration cards with a readable provider-sustainability table before retaining supporting concentration summaries.
decisions.rationale: A table makes the provider, observed basis, roster capacity, dates, status, and lineage comparable without implying a financial adjustment.

decisions.decision: Derive only a display status relative to the run valuation date.
decisions.rationale: Active, departed-before-valuation, future-start, and unavailable statuses explain supplied roster dates without altering financial populations.

decisions.decision: Show the terminal source-row number rather than the opaque lineage identifier in the primary table.
decisions.rationale: The source file and row remain traceable while the table stays readable; the full hash remains preserved in the run artifact.

observedBehaviour: The browser-rendered G4 page presents valuation date, four high-signal financial metrics, an explicit interpretation boundary, provider sustainability evidence, and supporting concentration context in that order.
PRV-004 is visually highlighted as Departed before valuation, with $17,331.26 observed billed, FTE 1, start date 2025-01-01, and end date 2026-04-14.
The browser-observed run 573bc172-0c62-41a7-af87-84171b94280e has valuation date 2026-06-30, one open finding, a 453931-cent A/R difference, G3 blocked, and G7 blocked.
The served asset was rebuilt after simplifying the roster trace to source file plus terminal row number.

evidence.result: Passed after the Analyze redesign and trace readability refinement.

evidence.reference: Browser screenshots supplied in the session for G4 Analyze
evidence.result: At 1920px, the hierarchy and provider table are readable; PRV-004 departure status is visible above supporting concentration views.
Live server serves the redesigned G4 asset and confirms the displayed PRV-004 values, retained open finding, and G3/G7 blocks.

durableKnowledge: Provider concentration alone is insufficient to communicate a provider-departure sustainability scenario.
G4 must distinguish source evidence, derived calculation, and professional judgment in both content and hierarchy.
Trace displays should preserve a human-readable source file and row while leaving full hashes in the persisted run artifact.
